name: Engineering Sciences (Environmental)
about: The Engineering Sciences (Environmental) major combines engineering principles with environmental science to address challenges related to water resources, air quality, waste management, and sustainability. Students develop a strong foundation in mathematics, chemistry, and biology alongside core environmental engineering coursework. The B.A. program provides flexibility for students to integrate environmental engineering with other disciplines, preparing graduates for careers in environmental consulting, policy, public health, and graduate study in environmental engineering and related fields.
